blocks.text: Facts here come from the municipality, TransLink or BC Transit, the Ministry of Education and Child Care, and the retailers’ own pages, listed under Sources. Walking and driving times were measured on OpenStreetMap routing on November 2, 2026, from the point named under the table.

items.t: No rapid-transit station is in Delta. Nearest rapid-transit station: Bridgeport Station (Canada Line), the terminus of TransLink Route 601 from Ladner.
Nearest bus exchange: Ladner Exchange, served by Routes 601, 606 and 608.
Route 601 Bridgeport Station/South Delta (TransLink): via Arthur Dr, Ladner Trunk Rd and Harvest Dr to Ladner Exchange, then via Hwy 99 to Bridgeport Station.
Route 606 Ladner Ring (TransLink): PM peak clockwise loop from Ladner Exchange via Harvest, 44 Ave, Arthur and River Rd.
Route 608 Ladner Ring (TransLink): AM peak counterclockwise loop from Ladner Exchange via 57 St, Admiral Blvd, River Rd and 44 Ave.

items.t: Official boundary: the City of Delta publishes no boundary for the Ladner Elementary name.

faq.q: Is "Ladner Elementary" an official City of Delta neighbourhood name?
faq.a: No — it is a Paragon sub-area name that follows Ladner Elementary School (5016 44 Ave., confirmed in the BC Ministry K-12 file); the planning area is Ladner under the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Which bus serves Arthur Drive near the schools?
faq.a: TransLink route 609 runs between South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange via Arthur Drive and Ladner Trunk Road, serving the Ladner Elementary and Delta Secondary area, and route 601 runs South Delta to Bridgeport Station via Ladner Exchange.

faq.q: Are suites allowed on single detached lots here?
faq.a: Yes, where the zone allows — the RS1 zone lists a secondary suite as an accessory use, Delta's SSMUH zoning updates allow up to four units on single-detached and duplex lots, and the amendments also cover coach houses and garden suites; confirm the lot's zone on the City zoning maps.
